name: mp-03-tracht-daylight
why: Full Bavarian Tracht - blue-white checked shirt and lederhosen - on the same staircase among Oktoberfest visitors.
prompt: Photorealistic candid street photograph. A powerfully built German man in his mid-forties walks down the broad stone staircase below the colossal bronze Bavaria statue at the Theresienwiese in Munich during Oktoberfest. His appearance: a strongly receding hairline, ash-blonde hair going grey, combed tight and straight back into a small low bun at the nape; a neat pointed goatee and moustache, blonde shading to grey, reaching a couple of centimetres below the chin; rimless eyeglasses with slim orange temple arms; a small stud earring. Heavy muscular build, very broad shoulders, thick neck, barrel chest, a slight softness at the waist, about 1.85 m. He wears traditional Bavarian Tracht: a blue and white checked cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearms, and brown deerskin lederhosen with an embroidered front flap and H-shaped leather braces across the chest, chunky grey wool calf-warmers and brown Haferl shoes. Mid-stride, one hand on the stone balustrade, glancing out over the fairground with a faint half-smile. Around him on the same wide steps, dozens of Oktoberfest visitors climb and descend: women in dirndls with patterned aprons, men in lederhosen and checked shirts, families and small groups, some photographing the view. Behind and above, the green-black bronze Bavaria and the sandstone columns of the Ruhmeshalle. Below, the Wiesn: rows of enormous beer tents with painted facades, flag poles, a Ferris wheel, dense crowds. Bright overcast daylight, soft even light. Shot on 35mm, natural colour, the man sharp, the crowd falling gently out of focus.

name: mp-04-tracht-goldenhour
why: Tracht with waistcoat at golden hour from a lower camera - warmer, more contrast, tighter on the subject.
prompt: Cinematic photorealistic photograph from slightly below. A powerfully built German man in his mid-forties climbs down the wide stone steps under the giant bronze Bavaria statue at Theresienwiese, Munich, at Oktoberfest. Strongly receding hairline, ash-blonde greying hair drawn tight back into a small low bun; a neat pointed blonde-grey goatee and moustache reaching just below the chin; rimless glasses with slim orange temples; a small stud earring. Very broad shoulders, thick neck, heavy muscular build with a slight belly, about 1.85 m. He wears Bavarian Tracht: a blue and white checked shirt, a fitted grey-brown wool Trachten waistcoat with horn buttons over it, and dark brown leather lederhosen with an embroidered flap and leather braces, wool socks and brown Haferl shoes. Caught mid-step, weight forward, relaxed. Low golden late-afternoon sun rakes in from the right, rim-lighting his shoulders and the bronze statue behind him, throwing long shadows down the steps. Other visitors in dirndls and lederhosen move around him on the staircase, warm backlight catching their outlines. Below stretches the Oktoberfest, beer-tent facades beginning to glow, a lit Ferris wheel, warm dust in the air. Deep blue shadow in the foreground against the warm light. Anamorphic 50mm look, shallow depth of field, rich contrast, fine film grain.
